images.title: Base, angle, mark, join
images.purpose: Show the finished construction of AB = 5 cm, angle A = 45°, AC = 4 cm.
images.composition: One triangle with the base horizontal at the bottom, with white space.
exact_structure: A horizontal teal (#0072B2) base AB labelled 5 cm, A at left, B at right.
From A an amber (#E69F00) arm rising to the right at 45° to AB, with a reddish purple (#CC79A7) arc and label 45° at A.
A point C on the arm exactly 4 cm from A, with a dot, the label C and the label 4 cm along AC.
A grey (#6B7280) segment BC closes the triangle, unlabelled.
The arm extends a little beyond C as a thin dashed grey (#6B7280) line.
rejection: C not on the arm at 4 cm from A
any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Make the angle at A, mark C along the arm at 4 cm, then join BC.
images.description: Triangle ABC with AB 5 cm, angle A 45° and AC 4 cm.
images.context: Shown beside the concept text and video for this concept.
images.teaching_notes: Follow the four steps with a finger: base, arm, mark, join.

image_decisions.why: The finished construction summarises the steps.
